articles.title: The capabilities and firepower of Greece’s Belharra: How the frigate “Kimon” reshapes the balance in the Aegean
articles.summary: Greece's Navy is acquiring the first of three advanced Belharra-type frigates, named "Kimon," marking a significant qualitative upgrade in its capabilities. This acquisition will establish a clear operational presence, particularly in the strategically vital Aegean Sea. These new frigates are set to bolster Greece's naval power and strategic influence, enhancing maritime security in the region.
